_readme: Copy this file to programs/<name>.json, edit, then add an entry to programs/profiles.json. Full field reference lives in schema.md. Fields starting with _ are ignored by the app — they exist as inline documentation and are safe to delete.

constraints: List any injuries or movement restrictions here — shown on their home screen

settings._showHotelVariant: true = show the 'Hotel gym' toggle (needs hotel overrides on exercises)

weeks.label: Week 1 — Getting started
weeks.note: Optional note shown at the top of every session this week.
